sections.content: A lo largo de sets a span of time a fact held true across (the fleet system, the Manila Galleon); como consecuencia de draws out what followed from a specific condition or event. Together they let a trade-history paragraph move between 'this held for centuries' and 'and because of that, X happened'. These sentences are taken directly from the previous reading.

items.spanish: A lo largo de casi todo el periodo colonial, el comercio legal estuvo organizado mediante un sistema de flotas.
items.english: Throughout almost the entire colonial period, legal trade was organized through a fleet system.

items.spanish: Como consecuencia de restricciones tan estrictas, se desarrolló un comercio ilegal, o contrabando.
items.english: As a consequence of such strict restrictions, an illegal trade, or contraband, developed.

items.spanish: A lo largo de dos siglos y medio, el llamado Galeón de Manila navegó anualmente entre Acapulco y Manila.
items.english: Over the course of two and a half centuries, the so-called Manila Galleon sailed annually between Acapulco and Manila.

items.spanish: Como consecuencia directa de esta ruta, ciudades como Acapulco se transformaron en mercados temporales enormes.
items.english: As a direct consequence of this route, cities like Acapulco transformed into enormous temporary markets.

sections.content: Como consecuencia de can take de + a noun (de restricciones, de esta ruta) or de + que + clause — both work, but the noun form reads more compact and is more common in formal writing like this.
